title: Chapter 936
text:
Interpais did not know what the financial group's name meant, but when Black Star mentioned this name, the weird smile on his face made him imagine a series of love and hate entanglements. It seemed to have a special meaning. He thought to himself but did not show it on his face.

Han Xiao shook his head, put away his thoughts, knocked on the table, and said, "When we reach the next planet, I will get someone to send you to the army headquarters in the Shattered Star Ring. When you get there, you will have time to slowly familiarize yourself with the work of the army. That's all I have to say. You can go now and do your homework."

"Okay." Interpais nodded, bowed, and left the room.

After he left the room, Sylvia could not help but roll her eyes and laugh.

"You're too vengeful. You actually came up with such a name."

Although she was not a Blue Star member, she had been under Han Xiao for many years and had heard about Han Xiao's early experiences from others.

"This is not vengeful." Han Xiao snorted.

Speaking of which, he, Hella, and Aurora should be the only three former members of the Germinal Organization left. Looking at it this way, the Germinal Organization was really full of crouching tigers and hidden dragons.

After teasing her for a while, Han Xiao said seriously, "Back to the topic, how's the situation in the Shattered Star Ring?"

Hearing this, Sylvia also stopped smiling and reported the progress of the competition between the Black Star Corps, Bloodshed Land, and the Limitless Financial Group. Ever since the competition broke out, Han Xiao had asked Sylvia to report the situation to him regularly.

Currently, the remaining companies of the Black Star Corps had joined forces on a large scale, which had curbed the hostile acquisitions of the Limitless Financial Group to a certain extent. The competition had turned into a tug of war. The Limitless Financial Group and Bloodshed Land had also temporarily changed their focus from purchasing business channels to consolidating the business channels that they had already obtained.

Thus, the role of the Bloodshed Land was displayed. With the identity of a Beyond Grade A organization, they were able to quickly digest the market seized by the Limitless Financial Group, causing the business scope of the Bloodshed Land to break through the mold and rapidly expand.

The two of them complemented each other to a certain extent. The Limitless Financial Group invested money to expand their territory, while the Bloodshed Land provided the influence and connections that they had accumulated over many years. Combining these resources, the efficiency of the cooperation between the two produced a chemical reaction, feeding each other and developing rapidly. They were catching up to the Black Star Corps in the Shattered Star Ring.

Otherwise, even if the Limitless Financial Group had so much money that even the Heaven and Earth Bank did not dare to print, the threat to him would be limited.

The Tyrant really knows how to launder money … After listening to the report, Han Xiao snorted.

If I don't rub you against the ground a hundred times after I advance, I'll write my surname backwards!

Han Xiao shook his head.

"I already know the situation. You can go back to work."

"Humph, you only know how to order people around. I can't even stay with you for a while longer. Ever since I became the Chief Administrative Officer, you've become more and more distant from me!" Sylvia wrinkled her nose unhappily.

"When did I?" Han Xiao was stunned.

"I don't care. I haven't had a holiday in a long time. I don't want to lose my hair like Jenny!" Sylvia angrily placed her hands on her hips. "Although I'm willing to work for the army, you can't treat me like a human! You don't really think that I like to work, do you? If not for you … Humph! "

Helpless, Han Xiao had no choice but to comfort Sylvia and calm her down.

In the eyes of the army members, Sylvia never complained and had a calm image. Only in front of him would Sylvia throw a tantrum.

On the next planet, Han Xiao ordered a few battleships and packed Interpais back to the Shattered Star Ring.

He then continued to run around the dynasty, looking for leeks while training his energy.

He traveled through the various Star Clusters and Star Systems in the Constellation Corridor. As time passed, the various organizations no longer found it strange.

After a long period of traveling, Han Xiao also slowly accumulated his energy to the critical point of Lv.19, getting closer and closer to the requirements of the Promotion mission.

…

"Hu …"

In the Gravity Training Room with the maximum gravity simulation environment, Han Xiao, who was half-naked, floated in midair. His eyes were emitting a strong light, and his mouth and nose were breathing in and out like lightning. His breathing formed a thundercloud, and his breathing was like thunder. His breathing was like thunder, and his breathing was like crackling lightning. His body was surrounded by dense Mechanical Force, and all kinds of signs showed that the energy in his body was in its most active state.

Han Xiao took a deep breath and retracted all his Mechanical Force back into his body. He then turned off the gravity mimicry. In his senses, the cells that were suppressed by gravity were freed from their restraints, and new energy was squeezed out.

"I've mastered another Energy Training Technique."

The light in Han Xiao's eyes dimmed, and he opened the interface to take a look. He nodded with satisfaction.

This was a Energy Training Technique that trained through gravity. Through the method of compression and release, the limit of the energy produced by the cells was increased. The number of times he could train had already reached the limit, and he had squeezed all the value out of it.

During this time, Han Xiao had already trained quite a few Energy Training Techniques, which had cost him a lot of experience and energy. Now, his energy limit had already reached around 119,000.

"Only one thousand left. I'm not far from Lv.19."

Han Xiao rubbed his shoulders, then controlled his body. He opened the closed sweat glands on his upper body, and sweat instantly gushed out like a fountain. However, the moment it left his body, it evaporated.

With his current life level, he could control his body perfectly. Whether he sweated or not was up to him. After intense exercise, it was fine if he did not want to sweat, but it would only make him feel a little uncomfortable.

After cleaning his body, Han Xiao touched his chest muscles, lowered his head, and admired his golden ratio muscular body. Only then did he put on the clothes.

The alloy door slid open, and Han Xiao walked out of the Gravity Training Room. He casually nodded to a group of crew members who passed by, then walked to the corridor and looked at the observation window.

The observation window displayed the external environment, and it could be zoomed in and out. At this time, the observation screen was overlooking the surface of a planet. A majestic galactic city was located there, and spaceships were taking off and landing, leaving behind streaks of light in the sky that did not disappear for a long time.

"Enya Hub, a famous galactic city in the Constellation Corridor, a high-level transit hub city." Han Xiao nodded.

This was a very lively galactic city that belonged to a Beyond Grade A ally of the dynasty. Because of its good management and location, Enya Hub had become a famous location in the dynasty.

However, Han Xiao did not come to this planet to recruit people. His fleet just happened to need to replenish their resources. Furthermore, Aurora and the other Black Star Guards expressed that they were tired of staying on the spaceship and wanted to go to the city to play. Thus, he brought his people to Enya Hub and had been there for a few days.

Because there were too many people coming and going, in order to not cause a commotion, Han Xiao had the fleet disguise themselves. At the same time, he had Philip conceal the information of his arrival and set up a fake identity. The artificial intelligence of Enya Hub was unable to detect it, and no one knew that he had come.

Opening the interface, there was a buff for the Evolutionary Totem on his status bar.

"This is also a planet equipped with the Evolutionary Totem." Han Xiao stroked his chin.

The sale of the Evolutionary Totem had been going on for quite some time, and the dynasty and its allies had already bought what they needed. They were already being used on a large scale and were usually used on colonial planets. It was rare for them to appear in a galactic transit hub.

Han Xiao had browsed through the information of Enya Hub for the past two years and realized that the Evolutionary Totem had attracted even more travelers. Some of the weaker races even took the initiative to send some of their people to live on neutral planets with the Evolutionary Totem.

A new migration phenomenon was created, and the influence of the Evolutionary Totem began to spread.

After sizing it up, Han Xiao left the corridor and went to the officers' activity room.

Usually, there would be many people playing cards here, but at this moment, it was very quiet. Less than half of the Black Star Guards were playing Wayne Cards.

Seeing Han Xiao, everyone turned to greet him and continued to focus on their game. Their brows were furrowed, as if they had met their match.

Han Xiao walked to the side of the table and looked around. Great, they were all noobs, and there was indeed no correlation between their combat strength and their card skills.

Looking around, Han Xiao did not see Fu Ding, Hardaway, and the others. He then patted someone's shoulder.

"Where did the others go?"

"Oh, they all went to Enya Hub to play. Hardaway brought a group of people to … cough cough, they went to that kind of bar. As for Fu Ding, I remember that he went shopping with Aurora." This Calamity Grade Black Star Guard scratched his head. "Do you want to call them back?"

"Forget it."

Han Xiao shook his head. Since he had nothing else to do, he could not be bothered to disturb his subordinates.

After thinking about it, he was not in a hurry to leave. Since he was only lacking 1,000 energy, he might as well stay there and focus on training the last bit of energy to complete the Promotion mission.

…

At the same time, in Enya Hub, Entertainment District 04.

A grand ceremony was being held there, and the streets were packed with people of different races. The parade cars moved slowly, and the performers made all kinds of strange movements toward the audience. From time to time, there would be street performers performing by the side of the street. It was very lively, and there was laughter everywhere.

Fu Ding and Aurora's faces were disguised, and they walked among the crowd. Aurora looked around curiously, while Fu Ding followed Aurora as her temporary bodyguard. He smiled and commented with Aurora about the performances around them from time to time.

"Sigh, it's too boring to stay on the ship for too long. It's more fun to be in a crowded place."

Aurora was holding a bunch of hot snacks in her hand. She was in a good mood as she chewed on them and spoke vaguely.

Hella liked to be alone, but Aurora preferred to be in a crowded place. Although the hardships of her childhood had caused her to suffer from social phobia for a period of time, after years of adjustment, she no longer had this problem.

She spent most of her time with Hella. Now that Hella was away, Aurora also wanted to walk around to increase her experience. However, liking crowds was not just a personality factor. There was also a physiological factor. Her Esper Ability could sense the aura of life. Places with many life signals would attract her to a certain extent. In such an environment, her Esper Ability would become more active, and she would feel happy.

"Oh, I prefer places with fewer people." Fu Ding shrugged.

Aurora rolled her eyes at him. "You like to be alone, right? Is it so fun to have spiritual sex? Are you two addicted? "

Fu Ding did not mind. He smiled faintly and pointed to his temple. "You're making her shy."

Aurora felt goosebumps. Just as she was about to say something, Fu Ding's eyes suddenly changed. He took a step forward, pressed on Aurora's shoulder, and stared in a direction.

"Wait, there seems to be a situation."

Seeing this, Aurora did not ask. She immediately put away her joking expression and threw away the snacks in her hand. She reached for the foldable gun at her waist and instantly got into a combat stance.

At the same time, she fully activated her Life Sensing Ability and followed Fu Ding's gaze. Suddenly, she found a few life signals that did not exist suddenly appeared in the distance. One of them was very weak and seemed to be in a state of serious injury.

The two looked at each other and quickly walked in the direction of the signal. They turned into an alley and walked through many corners. As they went deeper and deeper, there were gradually no traces of passersby.

Soon, the two arrived at the location of the abnormal life signals. However, there was an empty space in front of them. There was nothing unusual on the surface.

Fu Ding frowned and took out a magic badge from his pocket. This was a gift from Lagi. It was a device that could detect abnormal magic fluctuations. At this time, it was vibrating violently and pointed to the empty space in front of them.

"It seems to be a barrier magic. It can actually hide the city's magic detection device for a short period of time. The effect is not ordinary. To hide an area in the city, it doesn't seem like a good person. What is it doing?"

Fu Ding hesitated for a moment. He did not know if he should poke his nose into other people's business.

But before he could make a decision, the space in front of him suddenly shattered like glass and exploded with a bang!

Crack — —

The invisible barrier was broken from the inside, and a figure covered in blood staggered out and fell to the ground with a plop. The pool of blood under the body gradually expanded, and the empty space in front of the two suddenly changed, with a large number of potholes and traces of battle.

In addition to this wounded man, there were several other people standing in the distance. They were holding long-handled metal hammers with inscriptions. They were wearing black hooded robes with white patterns and symbols on them. They were wearing a few strands of special necklaces. They were dressed like priests or monks of some sect. Drops of blood dripped from the hammers.

Clearly, there had been a gang fight here.

Perhaps because the barrier was broken and they did not want to attract more attention, these people dressed as priests did not linger. They turned around and left at an extremely fast speed, quickly disappearing from the two's sight.

Fu Ding thought for a moment. Because he did not know the details of these people, he did not intend to chase after them. He went forward to support the heavily injured person who was on the verge of death.

However, before he could open his mouth to ask, the seriously injured man suddenly grabbed his clothes. His fingers clenched tightly as he spoke in a hoarse and urgent voice.

"Stop … stop … them …"

Before he could finish speaking, the wounded man fell down again and fell into a coma, leaving a bloody handprint on Fudin's clothes.

The two of them stared at each other.

"… What should we do?"

"Sigh, use your ability to save him. Since we met, we should at least ask what's going on. I have a feeling that this is not a small matter."

As he said that, Fu Ding shook his head helplessly and could not help but mutter to himself.
